00.name: Sweat
00.text: Left again!. Have you got moss for brains mortal.

lost_before_0.name: Sour
lost_before_0.text: Don't listen to Sweaty lumberer, everyone else knows your cool like me.

lost_before_1.name: Sweat
lost_before_1.text: Your not cool. You never have been cool and you never will.

lost_before_2.name: Sour
lost_before_2.text: Wahh wahh. Sounds like someone's mad cause the lumberer keeps agreeing with me and not you.

lost_before_3.name: Sour
lost_before_3.text: Looks like someones mad the lumberer is picking favourites.

lost_before_4.name: Sweat
lost_before_4.text: Grrr. Just you wait. I bet we're going to get lost again.

lost_before_5.name: Sour
lost_before_5.text: There's absolutly no way we're going to get lost again.

01.name: Sour
01.text: Nice choice lumberer. Thanks for not letting Sweaty persuade you like last time.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: I guess it's only fair since we went right last time. I still don't like it though.

03.name: Sour
03.text: Oh come on what's the worst that could happen.

04.name: Narrator
04.text: The group got lost. Use the 'wsd' or 'Up', 'Down' and 'Right' arrow keys in time with the beat to find your way back onto the trail.
